nodes.text:
Human metapneumovirus infections rose to 327 cases in 2024, up from 225 in 2023.

Although hMPV is not a new disease, MOH urges the public to stay vigilant, as respiratory infections are expected to persist, following global trends, especially in colder climates.

nodes.author: NewsBFM
nodes.text:
People are advised to practise good hygiene, including hand washing and wearing face masks in crowded or enclosed spaces.

High-risk individuals should also take extra precautions, and those with prolonged or worsening symptoms are encouraged to seek medical attention.
